mapper.select: SELECT b.tenant_id,b.project_id,b.source_version,b.parse_version,b.event_id,b.index_version,b.status AS build_status, b.revision,b.execution_started_at,b.execution_deadline,b.updated_at,i.expected_count,i.verified_count, i.status AS index_status,i.mode AS index_mode,b.manifest_sha256,i.manifest_sha256 AS index_sha256, v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,b.input_sha256,b.result_ref,c.result_ref AS receipt_ref, c.input_sha256 AS receipt_input_sha256,d.status AS delivery_status,b.schema_manifest_sha256, d.schema_manifest_sha256 AS delivery_schema,c.schema_manifest_sha256 AS receipt_schema, b.created_by,d.created_by AS delivery_creator,c.created_by AS receipt_creator FROM source_index_build b LEFT JOIN outbox_delivery d ON d.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND d.event_id=b.event_id AND d.consumer_id=b.consumer_id LEFT JOIN index_manifest i ON i.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND i.source_version=b.source_version AND i.parse_version=b.parse_version AND i.index_version=b.index_version LEFT JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND v.version_id=b.index_version AND v.entity_kind='INDEX_VERSION' LEFT JOIN consumer_receipt c ON c.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND c.event_id=b.event_id AND c.consumer_id=b.consumer_id WHERE b.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND b.project_id=#{projectId} AND b.consumer_id='SOURCE_INDEX_FULLTEXT' ORDER BY b.created_at,b.index_version LIMIT #{fetchLimit}

SELECT e.payload FROM outbox_event e JOIN processing_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.parse_version=e.aggregate_id AND a.attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND a.job_type='PARSE' WHERE e.event_id=#{eventId} AND e.event_type='source.index.requested' AND e.aggregate_revision=1 AND a.created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,event_id,source_version,parse_version,attempt_id,index_version,config_revision, rights_revision,input_sha256,manifest,manifest_sha256,status,execution_started_at,execution_deadline, result_ref,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,classification,revision FROM source_index_build WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND consumer_id='SOURCE_INDEX_FULLTEXT' AND created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,event_id,consumer_id,status,attempt_no,next_attempt_at,lease_owner,lease_until, lease_generation,last_error,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM outbox_delivery WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND consumer_id='SOURCE_INDEX_FULLTEXT' AND created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox_delivery d WHERE d.tenant_id=source_index_build.tenant_id AND d.event_id=source_index_build.event_id AND d.consumer_id=source_index_build.consumer_id AND d.created_by=#{userId} AND d.status='DELIVERING' AND d.lease_owner=#{workerId} AND d.lease_generation=#{generation} AND d.revision=#{leaseRevision} AND d.lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE index_manifest SET status='FAILED' WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND index_version=#{indexVersion} AND status='BUILDING' AND manifest_sha256=#{manifestSha256}
mapper.select: SELECT result_ref FROM consumer_receipt WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND consumer_id='SOURCE_INDEX_FULLTEXT' AND input_sha256=#{inputSha256} AND created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_chunk WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM index_item WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND index_version=#{indexVersion}

SELECT n.node_id AS nodeId,n.ordinal AS ordinal,n.node_kind AS nodeKind,n.locator AS locator,n.content_ref AS contentRef, n.node_hash AS nodeHash,c.chunk_id AS chunkId,c.raw_text AS rawText,c.search_text AS searchText,c.quote_hash AS quoteHash, c.locator AS chunkLocator,c.ordinal AS chunkOrdinal,cn.`range` AS nodeRange FROM content_node n JOIN source_chunk c ON c.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND c.source_version=n.source_version AND c.parse_version=n.parse_version AND c.node_id=n.node_id JOIN chunk_node cn ON cn.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cn.source_version=c.source_version AND cn.parse_version=c.parse_version AND cn.chunk_id=c.chunk_id AND cn.node_id=c.node_id WHERE n.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND n.parse_version=#{parseVersion} ORDER BY n.ordinal,n.node_id LIMIT #{fetchLimit}

SELECT i.mode AS mode,i.model_config_revision AS modelConfigRevision,i.dimension AS dimension, i.config_sha256 AS configSha256,i.manifest_sha256 AS manifestSha256,i.expected_count AS expectedCount, i.verified_count AS verifiedCount,i.status AS status,v.content_sha256 AS registeredSha256,v.owner_project_id AS ownerProjectId FROM index_manifest i JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND v.version_id=i.index_version AND v.entity_kind='INDEX_VERSION' WHERE i.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND i.parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND i.index_version=#{indexVersion} FOR UPDATE
